name: e2e-monorepo
description: An open framework for agentic end-to-end testing

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @e2edev/e2e run build && pnpm --filter @e2edev/playwright run build && pnpm --filter @e2edev/agent-device run build
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run check:dead-code && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run docs:check
scripts.release: pnpm run build && changeset publish --tag beta
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @e2edev/e2e run test && pnpm --filter @e2edev/playwright run test && pnpm --filter @e2edev/agent-device run test
